reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Lodge system requirements and regular lodge meetings
headings.reviewNote: Operating on lodge system requires supreme governing body, subordinate lodges, and periodic regular meetings.

headings.title: Optional children's lodges and voting exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Permits society to organize and operate lodges for children under adult minimum age without local initiation or voting voice (catchline typo reads 'children's wages').

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); lodge system and optional children's lodges verified (catchline typo 'children's wages' noted).

headings.title: Benefit provision and fraternal purposes of society
headings.reviewNote: Operates for benefit of members and beneficiaries through contractual benefits and fraternal, benevolent, or charitable purposes.

headings.title: Power to adopt and amend laws and rules
headings.reviewNote: Society has power to adopt and amend laws and rules for its government, member admission, and management.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); tightened subsection 2 title; § 378.616 benefit/fraternal purposes and governing law powers verified.

headings.title: Membership eligibility standards and benefit voting rights
headings.reviewNote: Laws must specify eligibility standards, child age thresholds (15-21), admission process, and restrict insurance voting to benefit members.

headings.title: Admission of social members without insurance voting voice
headings.reviewNote: Society may admit social members who possess no voice or vote in insurance management.

headings.title: Nonassignability of membership rights
headings.reviewNote: Membership rights in fraternal benefit society are personal to member and cannot be assigned.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); membership eligibility (age 15–21), social members, and nonassignability verified.

headings.title: Principal office location and English language proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Principal office must be in Missouri; governing meetings valid where subordinate lodge exists; minutes required in English.

headings.title: Official publications, member notice, and annual statement synopsis
headings.reviewNote: Notice validly published in official publication; annual statement synopsis mailed or published by June 1 each year.

headings.title: Bylaw grievance and complaint procedures for members
headings.reviewNote: Society may provide in its laws or rules for member grievance and complaint procedures.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); Missouri principal office, English minutes, official publication/June 1 synopsis, and grievance procedures verified.

headings.title: Personal liability immunity for officers and governing members
headings.reviewNote: Officers and members of supreme or subordinate bodies not personally liable for payment of society benefits.

headings.title: Indemnification of directors, officers, and employees
headings.reviewNote: Permits indemnifying directors, officers, employees, or agents; bars indemnification for adjudged breach of duty or compromise settlement unless good-faith best-interests standard met.

headings.title: Purchase of directors and officers liability insurance
headings.reviewNote: Society may purchase liability insurance on behalf of personnel regardless of society's power to indemnify under section.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); refined subsection 2 note on breach-of-duty/settlement good-faith indemnification standard; personal immunity and D&O insurance verified.

headings.title: Incorporation requirements and contents of articles
headings.reviewNote: Seven or more adult citizens, majority Missouri residents, execute articles stating name, purpose, management, and officer roster.

headings.title: Filing of articles, organizational documents, and surety bond
headings.reviewNote: Articles, bylaws, forms, and surety bond filed with director for review, certification, and preliminary charter.

headings.title: Duration and expiration of preliminary certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Preliminary certificate valid for one year, extendable by one year; charter void if organization uncompleted.

headings.title: Member solicitation and conditions precedent to issuing certificates
headings.reviewNote: May solicit members and collect advance monthly premiums; requires 500 applicants across 10 lodges and $150,000 premium trust.

headings.title: Director examination and final certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Director issues final certificate of authority upon compliance; record serves as prima facie evidence of corporate existence.

headings.title: Exemption from reincorporation for existing authorized societies
headings.reviewNote: Incorporated societies authorized to transact business when act became effective are not required to reincorporate.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); post-1-01-93 formation, $300k–$1.5M bond, 1-year preliminary charter, 500 applicants/10 lodges/$150k trust, and existing-society exemption verified.

headings.title: Bylaw amendment procedures and postal referendum
headings.reviewNote: Society amends laws at governing body meeting or by referendum; voting by mail permitted; majority approval within six months required.

headings.title: Director approval of bylaw amendments and sixty-day review
headings.reviewNote: Amendments effective upon director approval; deemed approved unless disapproved within sixty days with written reasons.

headings.title: Member notification of approved amendments within ninety days
headings.reviewNote: Amendments or synopsis furnished to members within ninety days by mail or official publication; mailing affidavit is prima facie evidence.

headings.title: Foreign society filing of certified bylaw amendments
headings.reviewNote: Foreign or alien societies must file certified copies of all amendments within ninety days of enactment.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect of certified printed amended laws
headings.reviewNote: Printed copies of laws certified by society secretary serve as prima facie evidence of legal adoption.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); domestic bylaw amendments, 60-day director deemed approval, 90-day member notice, foreign 90-day filing, and certified copies verified.

headings.title: Authority to operate not-for-profit charitable institutions
headings.reviewNote: Permits operating or establishing not-for-profit institutions to further § 378.605(1)(1) purposes free or at reasonable charge, with property reported in every annual statement.

headings.title: Prohibition on owning or operating funeral homes
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits any fraternal benefit society from owning or operating funeral homes or undertaking establishments.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); replaced completely mismatched subsection 2 title/note (drafted from sub 1) with funeral home/undertaking prohibition and corrected sub 1 note.

headings.title: Reinsurance agreements and portfolio cession approval
headings.reviewNote: Permits ceding individual risks (not to another society), requires written director permission for substantially all risks, and sets post-1-01-93 insolvency reserve-credit rules and § 375.246.

headings.title: Reinsurance of another society in consolidation or merger
headings.reviewNote: Permits a society to reinsure the risks of another society in a director-approved consolidation or merger under § 378.614 notwithstanding subsection 1.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); replaced completely mismatched subsection 2 title/note (drafted from sub 1 reserve credit) with § 378.614 merger/consolidation reinsurance.

headings.title: Consolidation or merger submission to director
headings.reviewNote: Domestic society presents contract, financial statements, two-thirds governing body certificate, and member notification proof to director.

headings.title: Director approval and interstate regulatory certification
headings.reviewNote: Director approves if contract is just and equitable; out-of-state societies must file home jurisdiction supervisory approval.

headings.title: Automatic vesting of property in surviving society
headings.reviewNote: Property, rights, and real estate title vest in surviving society without separate deed or conveyance instrument.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect of officer mailing affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Officer affidavit stating notice was addressed and mailed constitutes prima facie evidence of delivery to addressees.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); tightened subsection 3 title; two-thirds merger/consolidation filings, interstate approval, asset vesting, and mailing affidavit verified.

headings.title: Plan and vote to convert to mutual company
headings.reviewNote: Board drafts written conversion plan; requires two-thirds affirmative vote of supreme governing body.

headings.title: Director approval of mutual life conversion plan
headings.reviewNote: Conversion takes effect only upon approval of director after finding conformity with law and no prejudice to certificate holders.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); tightened subsection 1 title; two-thirds governing-body plan and director approval for mutual life conversion verified.

headings.title: Authorized contractual benefit categories
headings.reviewNote: Society may provide death, endowment, annuity, disability, medical/nursing, and monument benefits authorized for life insurers.

headings.title: Eligibility rules for covered persons and children
headings.reviewNote: Rules specify covered persons; adult may apply for benefits on lives of children under adult membership age.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); tightened subsection 2 title; authorized contractual benefits and member/dependent/child coverage rules verified.

headings.title: Right to change beneficiary and unvested revocable interests
headings.reviewNote: Owner may change beneficiaries unless irrevocable; revocable beneficiary has no vested interest prior to maturity.

headings.title: Funeral benefit payments capped at one thousand dollars
headings.reviewNote: Society may pay up to one thousand dollars for burial expenses incurred by equitably entitled person.

headings.title: Payment to personal representative or certificate owner
headings.reviewNote: Proceeds payable to personal representative or certificate owner if no lawful beneficiary survives.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); beneficiary changes, $1,000 funeral benefit ceiling, and default payment to personal representative or owner verified.

headings.title: Benefit certificate contents and representation status of applications
headings.reviewNote: Certificate specifies benefits; application, riders, and laws constitute contract; application statements are representations, not warranties.

headings.title: Binding effect of subsequent amendments on benefit contracts
headings.reviewNote: Subsequent amendments bind owner and beneficiaries but cannot diminish or destroy benefits contracted at issuance.

headings.title: Minors bound by benefit contract and society laws
headings.reviewNote: Persons insured prior to majority bound by application, certificate, and society laws as though of legal age.

headings.title: Reserve impairment remedies and benefit reduction options
headings.reviewNote: Laws must provide for owner payment of deficiency proportion; nonpayment results in certificate indebtedness or proportionate benefit reduction.

headings.title: Certified copies of society documents received in evidence
headings.reviewNote: Copies of contracts, applications, and rules certified by society secretary received in evidence of terms.

headings.title: Director approval required for delivery of certificate forms
headings.reviewNote: Certificate forms must be filed with and approved by director; specifies standard provisions, grace periods, and expulsion protections.

headings.title: Transfer of control and ownership on juvenile certificates
headings.reviewNote: Contracts on children below adult age may provide for transfer of control to insured at specified age upon application.

headings.title: Terms and conditions for assignment of benefit contracts
headings.reviewNote: Society may specify terms and conditions on which benefit contracts may be assigned.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); all eight benefit contract, amendment, minor binding, reserve impairment options, director form approval, juvenile transfer, and assignment subsections verified.

headings.title: Nonforfeiture values for certificates issued prior to 1994
headings.reviewNote: Certificates issued prior to one year after January 1, 1993, governed by nonforfeiture laws immediately prior to 1993.

headings.title: Nonforfeiture values and standard mortality table requirements
headings.reviewNote: Certificates issued on or after one year from January 1, 1993, must provide nonforfeiture and cash surrender values matching life insurer laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); pre-1994 and post-1994 nonforfeiture/cash surrender standards and Commissioner's standard mortality tables verified.

headings.title: Creation and maintenance of society funds and assets
headings.reviewNote: Assets held, invested, and disbursed for society purposes; no member acquires individual property rights or apportionment rights.

headings.title: Authority to establish special purpose funds
headings.reviewNote: Permits society to create, maintain, invest, disburse, and apply special funds necessary to carry out any purpose permitted by its laws.

headings.title: Authority to establish separate accounts and variable benefits
headings.reviewNote: Society may establish separate accounts and issue variable contracts in accordance with life insurer regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); refined subsection 2 title/note to match statutory special-purpose funds wording; asset ownership and variable separate accounts verified.

headings.title: Valuation standards for certificates issued prior to 1994
headings.reviewNote: Valuation standards for certificates issued prior to one year after January 1, 1993, governed by prior laws.

headings.title: Minimum valuation standards and approved mortality tables
headings.reviewNote: Minimum valuation standards based on Commissioner's standard mortality tables for life and life insurer standards for disability/annuities.

headings.title: Director authority to accept alternative or substandard valuation
headings.reviewNote: Director may accept alternative standards producing adequate reserves and vary mortality standards for substandard or hazardous lives.

headings.title: Maintenance of excess reserves with regulatory consent
headings.reviewNote: Society may maintain excess reserves with domiciliary regulator consent, without affecting contractual rights of benefit members.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); pre-/post-1994 valuation standards, Commissioner's tables, substandard lives, and excess reserves verified.

headings.title: Annual financial statement filing by March first
headings.reviewNote: Verified statement of financial condition filed annually by March 1 using NAIC forms with filing fee; director may extend.

headings.title: Certified actuarial valuation of certificates in force
headings.reviewNote: Society files certificate valuation certified by qualified actuary by March 1; director may grant up to two-month extension.

headings.title: Daily fine and suspension for delinquent filings
headings.reviewNote: Failure to file annual statement subject to fine of one hundred dollars per day and potential suspension of authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); tightened subsections 1 and 3 titles; March 1 NAIC statement, § 378.625 actuarial valuation, and $100/day fine/suspension verified.

headings.title: Director examination authority and confidentiality pending response
headings.reviewNote: Director may examine domestic, foreign, or alien societies as with insurers; findings confidential until society has opportunity to respond.

headings.title: Payment of examination and valuation expenses by society
headings.reviewNote: Expenses of examination and valuation, including examiner compensation and expenses, paid by society examined upon director statement.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); domestic/foreign/alien society examinations, response confidentiality, and expense payment verified.

headings.title: Grounds for deficiency notice and thirty-day cure period
headings.reviewNote: Director serves written deficiency notice for insolvency, ultra vires acts, or hazards; society allowed thirty days to comply.

headings.title: Director action for injunction or quo warranto
headings.reviewNote: Permits director to commence an action to enjoin the society from transacting business or in quo warranto if society fails to show good and sufficient cause.

headings.title: Conditions for dissolving court injunction and license reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Injunction dissolved and license reinstated upon correction of violation, payment of costs, and director approval.

headings.title: Court liquidation proceedings and receiver appointment
headings.reviewNote: If liquidation ordered, society enjoined, receiver takes possession and liquidates assets pursuant to sections 375.1150 to 375.1246.

headings.title: Application of liquidation procedures to voluntary discontinuance
headings.reviewNote: Injunction, hearing, and receivership procedures apply to societies voluntarily deciding to discontinue business.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); corrected subsection 2 title/note (director—not attorney general—commences injunction or quo warranto); §§ 375.1150–375.1246 liquidation verified.

headings.title: Foreign society deficiency notice, thirty-day cure, and suspension
headings.reviewNote: Director notifies foreign society of deficiencies with 30 days to comply; show-cause hearing may result in suspension or revocation.

headings.title: Good faith continuation of existing contracts upon suspension
headings.reviewNote: Suspension or revocation does not prevent society from continuing in good faith all contracts legally made in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); foreign/alien society 30-day deficiency notice, suspension/revocation, and good-faith contract continuation verified.

headings.title: Insurance producer licensing under chapter 375
headings.reviewNote: Society agents must be licensed under chapter 375; agents active six months prior to October 13, 1969, exempt from examination.

headings.title: Licensing exemptions for salaried officers and casual solicitors
headings.reviewNote: Salaried employees not soliciting for commission and representatives devoting under 50% time and under 25 policies exempt.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1992, 2015); ch. 375 agent licensing (pre-10-13-69 exam exemption) and salaried/casual solicitor exemptions verified.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for fraudulent membership applications
headings.reviewNote: Knowing false or fraudulent statement in membership application or to obtain money is class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Perjury penalty for false sworn reports or claims
headings.reviewNote: Willful false statement under oath in report or proof of death/disability constitutes perjury under criminal law.

headings.title: Infraction for soliciting membership in unlicensed society
headings.reviewNote: Knowingly soliciting membership for unlicensed fraternal society is an infraction.

headings.title: General infraction penalty for chapter noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Knowing violation or neglect of chapter provisions lacking specific penalty constitutes an infraction.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); tightened subsection 2 title; class A misdemeanor application fraud, sworn-claim perjury, and unlicensed/general infractions verified.

headings.title: Exempt societies, craft orders, and limited benefit groups
headings.reviewNote: Chapter does not apply to craft lodges, or municipal/religious groups with death benefits under $500 or disability under $350.

headings.title: Exceptions to exemption for large societies issuing certificates
headings.reviewNote: Exemption inapplicable to societies issuing certificates or religious groups with over two thousand members.

headings.title: Prohibition on member procurement compensation in exempt groups
headings.reviewNote: Exempt societies prohibited from offering compensation for procuring new members, craft orders excepted.

headings.title: Exemption from ritualistic ceremonies for religious denominations
headings.reviewNote: Society whose membership is confined to single religious denomination not required to conduct ritualistic ceremonies.

headings.title: Relicensing and exemptions for accident-only societies
headings.reviewNote: Existing societies providing solely accident benefits relicensed without medical exams, valuations, or specific benefit clauses.

headings.title: Director authority to verify exempt society status
headings.reviewNote: Director may require information by examination or otherwise to determine whether society is exempt from chapter.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1992 note (effective 1-01-93); exempt lodges/craft/limited-benefit groups, >2,000-member/certificate exceptions, procurement pay ban, religious ritual exemption, and accident-only relicensing verified.
